# Letterhome

> Letterhome is a Canadian letter and document mailing service. Customers anywhere in the world upload a PDF or Word document online, and Letterhome prints it in black & white by default (colour available for an extra fee), seals it in an envelope, and mails it from inside Canada via Canada Post Lettermail, with a real Canadian mailing date. No Canadian address, printer, stamps, or post office visit required. From $10 CAD per letter.

Letterhome is used by Canadians living abroad, immigrants sending documents to Canadian government offices (IRCC, CRA), expats sending letters to family, and anyone who needs a letter to arrive with a Canadian mailing date.

## Pricing

- $10 CAD: letters to any Canadian address (domestic)
- $20 CAD: letters to any of 160+ international destinations

Both prices include up to 5 pages printed in black & white, the envelope, postage, and delivery. Colour printing, extra pages, registered mail, a large envelope, and scheduled sending are available as paid add-ons, shown before checkout. No account required. Pay once per order.

## How it works

1. Fill in the recipient address, compose or attach your letter, and enter your email.
2. Pay by credit or debit card through Stripe.
3. Letterhome prints the letter in full colour and mails it from Canada, usually within one business day.
4. The customer receives an email confirmation with an order tracking link.

## Delivery

Letters are mailed via Canada Post standard lettermail:
- Within Canada: typically up to 2 weeks
- International: typically up to 4 weeks

## Where to mail it: specific addresses

Verified mailing addresses (sourced from canada.ca, IRCC, and each bank's own site) for common documents newcomers, immigrants, and non-residents need to mail to Canada. Addresses can change; each page links to its official source.

- [Where to mail a non-resident tax return to Canada](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-non-resident-tax-return-to-canada): CRA Winnipeg and Sudbury tax centre addresses for non-resident T1 filers, by country of residence
- [Where to mail CRA non-resident withholding forms (NR73/NR74)](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-cra-non-resident-withholding-forms): CRA Non-Resident Withholding Section address in Sudbury
- [Where to mail a CRA non-resident tax waiver application](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-cra-waiver-application-ottawa): CRA International Waivers Centre of Expertise address in Ottawa
- [Where to mail a non-resident GST/HST registration](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-non-resident-gst-hst-registration): CRA Non-Resident Registration and Security unit at the Atlantic Tax Centre, Summerside PE
- [Where to mail a Canadian citizenship application](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-canadian-citizenship-application): IRCC CPC-Sydney PO Boxes for citizenship grants and resumptions
- [Where to mail proof of citizenship documents](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-proof-of-citizenship-documents): IRCC CPC-Sydney PO Boxes for proof of citizenship, search requests, and requested documents
- [Where to mail a PR card renewal](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-pr-card-renewal-canada): IRCC Sydney PO Boxes for permanent resident card renewal and replacement
- [Where to mail IRCC sponsorship documents](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-ircc-sponsorship-documents-mississauga): IRCC Digitization Centre address for CPC-Mississauga correspondence and right of permanent residence fee payments
- [IRCC mailing addresses by application type](https://letterhome.ca/ircc-mailing-addresses-by-application-type): Overview and index of IRCC mailing addresses by application type
- [Where to mail signed Scotiabank documents](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-scotiabank-documents-canada): Scotiabank's published head office and correspondence addresses
- [Where to mail signed TD documents](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-td-bank-documents-canada): TD's published Customer Care mailing address
- [Where to mail documents to the University of Toronto](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-university-of-toronto): University Registrar's published mailing address for transcripts and supporting documents
- [Where to mail documents to UBC admissions](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-ubc-admissions): UBC Enrolment Services' published Vancouver-campus mailing address, used for all UBC applications
- [Where to mail transcripts to McGill University](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-transcripts-mcgill-university): McGill's published Enrolment Services address for undergraduate admission documents
- [Where to mail documents to Waterloo graduate admissions](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-university-of-waterloo): Waterloo GSPA's published Needles Hall courier address for graduate applicants
- [Where to mail documents to Queen's University](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-queens-university): Office of the University Registrar's published Gordon Hall, Room 125 mailing address
- [Where to mail documents to the University of Victoria](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-university-of-victoria): Office of the Registrar's published PO Box 3025 STN CSC address
- [Where to mail documents to Dalhousie University](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-dalhousie-university): Registrar's Office address in Halifax from Dalhousie's own faculty and staff guide
- [Where to mail documents to Simon Fraser University](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-simon-fraser-university): Registrar and Information Services address on SFU's Burnaby campus
- [Where to mail documents to WES Canada](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-wes-canada): World Education Services' published Newmarket, ON PO Box for credential assessment documents
- [Where to mail documents to IQAS Alberta](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-to-iqas-alberta): Alberta government's published mailroom address, the only channel for IQAS document submission
- [Where to mail documents to ICES British Columbia](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-to-ices-bc): BCIT's published mailing address for the International Credential Evaluation Service
- [Where to mail documents to the Federal Court of Canada](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-documents-federal-court-of-canada): Courts Administration Service's published Ottawa registry address for filings such as immigration judicial review
- [Where to mail an Ontario birth certificate application](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-ontario-birth-certificate-application): ServiceOntario's published Thunder Bay P.O. Box for the Office of the Registrar General
- [Where to mail an Ontario name change application](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-ontario-name-change-application): ServiceOntario's published Thunder Bay P.O. Box for legal name change applications
- [Where to mail BC vital statistics documents](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-bc-vital-statistics-documents): BC Vital Statistics Agency's published Victoria P.O. Box for birth, marriage, death, and name-change requests
- [Where to mail Quebec vital statistics documents](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-quebec-vital-statistics-documents): Directeur de l'état civil's published Québec City address for birth, marriage, and death certificate requests
- [Where to mail Manitoba vital statistics documents](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-manitoba-vital-statistics-documents): Vital Statistics Branch's published Winnipeg address for birth, marriage, and death certificate requests
- [Where to mail a Canadian passport application](https://letterhome.ca/where-to-mail-a-canadian-passport-application): Service Canada's domestic mail-in addresses by province, plus guidance for applying from outside Canada
